eyes.sharpness: Must be sharp and in focus
eyes.pupils: Visible, properly sized, not blown out or missing
eyes.avoid: Blurry eyes, distorted eyes, missing pupils, unnatural eye shape

mouth.teeth: Natural teeth anatomy, no bad teeth, proper alignment
mouth.lips: Natural lip shape, proper lip-teeth boundary
mouth.expression: Neutral or natural expression, not forced
mouth.avoid: Bad teeth, unnatural mouth, lip-teeth boundary failed, unnatural expression

skin.texture: Natural skin texture with appropriate aging signs
skin.lighting: Even lighting without harsh shadows or blown highlights
skin.avoid: Over-smoothed skin, plastic look, inconsistent tone

hands_quality.fingers: Correct number of fingers, proper proportions
hands_quality.joints: Natural finger joints, no extra or missing joints
hands_quality.avoid: Broken hands, extra fingers, missing fingers, distorted joints

composition_quality.framing: Proper headroom, subject fully in frame
composition_quality.rule_of_thirds: Eye line on upper third line preferred
composition_quality.avoid: Over-tight crops, top of head cropped, head not fully in frame, distracting background

detail_quality.sharpness: Critical areas (face, hands) must be sharp
detail_quality.texture: Fabric, hair, skin textures must be visible
detail_quality.avoid: Low detail, mushy image, loss of texture in critical areas

style_quality.consistency: Must match brief and style direction
style_quality.color: Natural color palette, no color casts
style_quality.avoid: Wrong style, inconsistent with brief, unnatural lighting, color casts

quality_barriers.repairability_required: All defects must have known repairability assessment

quality_validation.technical_metrics: Blur, brightness, contrast must be within acceptable ranges
